summary: Traffic lane approaching a signalised junction; no parking and nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Main road approach lane, no parked cars
Painted chevrons and junction at the end

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east side; school buildings 20 m and more away across the road; nearest home 45 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a live lane with a painted island and no bay or verge to stop clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Busy road and signalised junction with moving cars, noisy.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the kerb; only moving traffic seen.

sun_shade: Dense trees shade the kerb from the east in the morning; open to afternoon sun.
